topic: What frequency planning challenges arise when coordinating multiple ground stations with overlapping satellite visibility windows?
response: Frequency planning challenges arise when coordinating multiple ground stations with overlapping satellite visibility windows, including potential in-line interference between geostationary (GSO) and non-geostationary (NGSO) satellites. This can occur due to their beams pointing to the same location and operating on the same frequency.
reference_context: The provided context mentions in-line interference challenges for NGSO satellites, particularly between GSO and NGSO satellites with overlapping visibility windows, which requires tight coordination to mitigate.
